caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical container resembling a mug or vessel, colored in various shades of brown. The object has a rounded handle attached to its side and stands on three short, evenly spaced legs. The surface of the vessel features multiple small, circular holes arranged in horizontal rows around the perimeter. The interior of the vessel is depicted in a darker brown tone, emphasizing its depth. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decoration present. The artist's signature is located in the bottom right corner.
title: Cheese Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
